A1.definition: rows = every engine row (RB/WR/TE, expected snaps > 0, at least one prior game, played); binding = expected snaps within 1 snap of the prior raw-snap high (the raw ceiling) while best prior snap share x the engine expected team plays is at least 1 snap higher; non-binding rows are unchanged under every rule

real.definition: share of the absent regulars' prior target share (V) gained by each remaining group, actual target share minus the player's own prior share (prior games with the absent player active); replacement = same-position player with the largest snap-share rise
